entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you help me understand the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a defect. The heart rate tracking is wildly inaccurate. Half the time it doesn't even pick up a signal. Honestly, for what I paid, this thing is garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing that. That's definitely not the quality we aim for at VeloFit. I'd be happy to connect you with our technical support team; they can troubleshoot and verify the fault for a replacement.
No, thank you. I really don't have time to go back and forth with a tech team. I've lost confidence in the product. I just want my money back, so I'd like to process a refund.
I understand completely. You'd prefer a refund rather than a replacement. Let me just pull up your order details and review our return eligibility. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I see your VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 31st, which was 19 days ago. Let me check the policy.

Alright, I've confirmed it here. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 19, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.
Oh, wonderful. That's much simpler than I thought it would be. I appreciate you making that easy.

Of course. And I also see here that you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble you've had with this device, I'd like to add a 20% discount code to your account for your next purchase, should you decide to try another VeloFit product in the future.
That's very kind of you, thank you, Alex. I might just do that.

You're most welcome. I'm emailing you the prepaid return shipping label as we speak. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box and drop it off. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
